title: Maximum Circular Subarray
summary: Return the greatest nonempty subarray sum when the ends are adjacent, or 0 for empty input.
statement: Return the greatest nonempty subarray sum when the ends are adjacent, or 0 for empty input. Implement `maximum_circular_subarray` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: A wrapping maximum equals total sum minus a minimum middle segment.
Compare the ordinary maximum with total minus the minimum, guarding the all-negative case.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the maximum_circular_subarray invariant is complete.
Editorial: Compare the ordinary maximum with total minus the minimum, guarding the all-negative case. The intended bounds are O(n) time and O(1) space.
